artworks.title: Girl Sleeping on Settee
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in an armchair. The person is in a relaxed position, with their head tilted to one side. The facial features are not distinct, and the person's hair appears short. The clothing suggests a long robe or gown, with fabric flowing around the individual. The person is not holding any objects, and no jewelry is visible. The background has a textured wall or curtain pattern and a striped pattern on the floor.

artworks.title: Young Man Writing by Lamplight
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a table, leaning forward and writing or drawing with their right hand. Their left hand supports their posture. The person has long hair tied back, and is wearing a long-sleeved, formal outfit. On the table are a bottle of ink and a lamp. The background features a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Young Man Seated, Smoking
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated in a chair. The individual has a relaxed posture, leaning slightly to one side with one hand resting on what appears to be a table. The person's facial features are detailed, with eyes cast downward and a neutral expression. They are wearing a long robe and a cap. The person holds a long pipe emitting smoke, and there is a cylindrical container on the table beside them. The background has a textured, lined pattern that extends onto the floor with a striped pattern under the chair and table.

artworks.title: Young Man Bareheaded, with Sword
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their arms crossed over their chest. The person has short curly hair, a neutral facial expression, and wears historical clothing. They carry a sword at their side. The background includes a house, foliage, and a textured sky, and the scene is in black and white.

artworks.title: Young Man with Cane
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man standing upright in profile, facing slightly to the right. He has a pointed nose, a sharp chin, and wears a tri-cornered hat. His attire includes a long coat, knee-length breeches, knee-high stockings, and a long cravat. He is holding a walking cane in his right hand. The background shows a simple, textured landscape with sparse foliage around his feet.

artworks.title: Young Man with Hat under Arm
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a person in profile. The individual is standing upright with one foot slightly in front of the other, and their hands are clasped in front of them at waist level. The person has distinct facial features and styled hair pulled back in a fashion typical of the 18th century. They are dressed in elegant attire of the era, including a long fitted coat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. A tree and dense foliage are visible in the background, suggesting a garden or park-like setting. The image is framed by a rectangular border with a light textured background.

artworks.title: Young Man with Sword, Cane and Dog
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking alongside a dog. The man is walking in profile, holding a walking stick, dressed in a long coat with tails, high boots, and a tricorn hat adorned with a feather. His hair is styled with curls extending down from beneath the hat. The man's facial features are depicted with a defined nose and chin, and his head is slightly tilted back. His attire appears elaborate, with detailed embroidery and texture on his coat. Alongside him, a slender dog with a narrow head and erect tail walks closely. The scene is set against a backdrop featuring stylized clouds and a landscape that provides a textured ground beneath the man and dog. The entire scene is framed with a thin border.

artworks.title: Infancy
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a wooden bench outdoors, cradling a small child. She wears a head covering or bonnet, and a long gown. Lush foliage surrounds them, with trees and a rustic building in the background. The sky has soft clouds. The style of the image is intricate and pastoral.

artworks.title: Childhood
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a woman and a young girl engaged in conversation by a wooden bench. The scene features detailed textures of fabric, foliage, and architecture. In the background, there is a rustic setting with trees and a small cottage. Delicate clouds stretch across the top of the composition, creating a sense of depth. The use of hatching and cross-hatching in a monochrome palette captures light and shadow, adding realism to the scene. The overall tone is one of tranquility and elegance.

artworks.title: Lovers
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional pastoral scene with two individuals sitting on a bench under a large tree. In the background, there are distant houses and trees on the horizon under a cloudy sky. The artwork is depicted using an engraving technique with detailed linear brushstrokes, creating a monochromatic sepia tone palette. The composition blends nature and human elements harmoniously, creating a serene and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bethrothal
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a couple in a natural setting. The perspective captures both the couple and their surroundings, with a high horizon emphasizing the landscape and distant buildings under a sky with clouds. The man and woman are depicted with lines and shading, framed by large trees. The etching uses fine lines for texture in the foliage and clothing. The color palette is sepia, giving an antique feel to the image.

artworks.title: Growing Family
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered under a tree in a pastoral setting. The group includes adults and children in detailed attire and expressions, set in front of a landscape with trees, a distant structure, and a house with a thatched roof. The background features cloud forms, all depicted in monochrome tones of brown.

artworks.title: Family Grown
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered outdoors under a tree. The scene depicts several individuals, some sitting on chairs and others standing, in a tranquil rural setting with a thatched-roof house and tree-filled landscape in the background. The composition is densely filled with delicate linework, focusing on the detailed rendering of the figures and their surroundings, such as the textured leaves and the varied expressions and postures of the individuals. The overall ambiance is calm, capturing a moment of interaction amidst nature.

artworks.title: Grandparents
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene featuring figures engaged in leisure activities. The image depicts a group of figures gathered in a wooded area, under a tree, with a thatched-roof house visible in the background. To the left, two figures are engaged in conversation. To the right, a group stands in a circular formation. The background includes lush foliage, trees, and rolling clouds in the sky. The drawing emphasizes texture and shading, enhancing the bucolic setting.

artworks.title: Death
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered outdoors. In the background, there are trees and a thatched-roof building. The brushstrokes are fine and intricate, typical of an etching technique, highlighting details in the vegetation and clothing textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia. Closest to the viewer, a group is gathered around a table with a jug and glass. Two women stand to the left, one gesturing. A family group is seated and standing by the table. More trees and a structure are in the background, blending into the sky.

artworks.title: Title Page with Fountain
artworks.medium: etching with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a large rock formation slightly off-center. The rock is detailed with textures through fine lines. Inscriptions are visible on the rock's surface. Trees frame the scene on either side of the rock, with swirling strokes for leaves and fine lines for trunks and branches. The horizon line is below the rock, depicted by grassy terrain. The sky shows delicate horizontal lines suggesting clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Title Page with Fountain
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a stone structure extending into the middle. The stone wall dominates the upper portion, appearing unfinished or partially destroyed. The brushstrokes resemble fine, detailed etching lines. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of black lines against a creamy background. Trees frame the scene, with clouds lightly etched in the sky.

artworks.title: Dog and Cat
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows two dogs lying on the ground. The drawing uses stark contrasts and heavy cross-hatching to depict the scene. The intricate line work emphasizes the fur of the dogs, capturing their forms in a detailed yet somewhat abstract manner. Strong shadows and highlights are present, suggesting a somber ambiance. The composition gives a sense of tranquility and stillness to the image.

artworks.title: Two Asses
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two donkeys standing near a building. The image depicts two donkeys standing closely together on a patch of ground. Behind them stands a rustic building with a partially open window. A vine climbs up part of the building. In the background, there is a faint depiction of a landscape with an additional animal.

artworks.title: Two Carts
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a winding path, scattered trees, structures like a thatched-roof house, and horse-drawn carts. In the distance, there is a castle or large building complex with a tower on a hill. Mountains dominate the skyline. The black and white etching technique creates detailed textures and depth. The sky is filled with linear patterns.

artworks.title: Three Cottages
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a rustic scene with various natural and man-made elements. The horizon is high in the image, aligned with the tree tops creating a natural wall. To the left, a building with a steep roof is partially visible above dense foliage. Two figures are walking on a dirt path winding around weathered wooden structures that resemble sheds or barns. Planks and smaller branches are scattered about. The scene is depicted with fine, meticulous brushstrokes, detailing textures of trees, leaves, and wooden surfaces. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on shades of tan and brown, creating a warm, sepia-toned quality.

artworks.title: Three Cottages
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a rural scene with a humble setting. The view is slightly elevated, showing the surroundings. There are trees on the horizon, with a building partially concealed by them. Two figures are walking on a path in the foreground. The etching shows detailed texture and ruggedness in the landscape and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on form and detail. The composition conveys a rustic and tranquil atmosphere, emphasizing rural simplicity.

artworks.title: The Knoll
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed etched scene depicting a lush landscape with a cabin nestled among trees. The horizon is not clearly defined, with intricate details of foliage, rocks, and the cabin. The artwork utilizes fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette. Figures and rock formations are present, adding human elements to the serene environment. The scene is framed by trees and branches, creating a dramatic composition.

artworks.title: Large Rock
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing an outdoor scene with rocky formations, trees, and a low horizon. The artwork utilizes fine lines to depict textures such as rocks, foliage, and clouds. A figure is seated on a rock in the foreground. In the distance, there are trees, a small building, and a dirt path leading further into the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of etchings, creating depth and contrast through line variations.
